reports.title: Taiko Findings & Analysis Report (Code4rena)
reports.description: Code4rena competitive audit (March 6-27, 2024) of the 81 Taiko protocol contracts in the contest mirror repository, covering the L1 rollup libraries, L2 anchor contract, bridge, signal service, vaults, SGX verifier and attestation, governance, airdrop and token-pool contracts. It reports five High and fourteen Medium findings; the sponsor-named fix pull requests in taiko-mono were not reviewed by the wardens.

reports.title: Taiko Protocol Audit (OpenZeppelin)
reports.description: Three-phase OpenZeppelin audit of the Taiko protocol contracts in taiko-mono: phases 1 and 2 at b47fc34 covered TaikoL1/L2 and libraries, tiers and verifiers, bridge, signal service, vaults, governance, token and grants contracts, and phase 3 at dd8725f covered the Bridge, QuotaManager, DelegateOwner, BridgedTaikoToken, BridgedERC20 and ERC20Vault. It reports 2 Critical and 3 High findings (H-02 only partially resolved), with fixes reviewed at the commits named per finding.

reports.title: Taiko Ontake Fork Audit (OpenZeppelin)
reports.description: OpenZeppelin diff audit of the Ontake fork changes to the Taiko L1 rollup libraries, TaikoL1, TaikoL2 and Lib1559Math since b47fc34, plus full review of the new LibBonds, LibData and compose verifiers, at fd1c039 of the private taiko-mono-oz-audit mirror (commit also served by taiko-mono). It reports no Critical or High findings; all Medium, Low and Note findings were resolved in follow-up pull requests.

reports.title: Halborn Taiko DAO Contracts Security Assessment (Draft)
reports.description: Draft Halborn assessment of the Taiko DAO Aragon plugins (optimistic token voting, multisig and emergency multisig, SignerList, EncryptionRegistry, DelegationWall, factory and plugin setups) in aragon/taiko-contracts at eed36d3. It reports 3 Low and 12 Informational findings, all pending, including two Low findings dropped from the final report.

reports.title: Halborn Taiko Alethia Protocol Audit for the Pacaya Upgrade
reports.description: Halborn assessment of the Pacaya-upgrade contracts TaikoInbox, TaikoWrapper, ForcedInclusionStore and ERC20Vault in taikoxyz/taiko-mono at a1e4ed7, reporting 1 Critical, 1 High, 4 Medium, 2 Low and 1 Informational finding. All findings were marked solved with per-finding remediation commits.

reports.title: Halborn Taiko DAO Contracts Security Assessment
reports.description: Final Halborn assessment of the Taiko DAO Aragon plugins and factory in aragon/taiko-contracts at eed36d3, with 1 Low and 12 Informational findings. Remediations were reviewed in six commits of pull request #50.

reports.title: OpenZeppelin Taiko Shasta Protocol Re-Audit
reports.description: OpenZeppelin diff re-audit (2025-12-15 to 2025-12-24) of the redesigned Shasta protocol contracts in taikoxyz/taiko-mono, covering the diff 5034456...430b332, a second diff 430b332...2ad7378 and full reviews of new files at 430b332. It reports 3 Low and 3 Note findings, fixed in pull requests #21161-#21166.

reports.title: OpenZeppelin Taiko Shasta Protocol Audit
reports.description: OpenZeppelin audit (2025-11-10 to 2025-12-05) of the Shasta protocol contracts in taikoxyz/taiko-mono at 5034456: Inbox variants, codecs and libraries, forced inclusion, PreconfWhitelist, SGX/RISC0/SP1 and compose verifiers, Anchor, BondManager and SignalService. It reports 6 Critical, 2 High, 4 Medium, 9 Low and 7 Note findings with fixes in per-finding pull requests.

Fixes were verified on main at f7a12b8 plus a few follow-up pull requests.

reports.title: Taiko Smart Contract Security Assessment (Sigma Prime)
reports.description: Sigma Prime security assessment of all Solidity contracts in the taiko-mono protocol directories (4844, bridge, common, L1, L2, libs, signal, thirdparty, tokenvault), covering the contestable rollup, prover assignment hooks, SGX verifier, bridge and vaults. It reports 3 Critical and 5 High findings, all resolved in the listed pull requests and retested at 59c322d.
